# Introducing Paris

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Paris featuring attractions, museums, neighborhoods, and practical transportation information for visitors.

Introducing Paris provides detailed guides to Paris's landmarks, museums, and districts including the Latin Quarter, Montmartre, and Île de la Cité. The site covers practical visitor information such as opening hours, ticket prices, public transport options, and interactive maps powered by Google Maps and Google Earth.

## Key Topics

- Paris attractions and monuments
- Latin Quarter and historic neighborhoods
- Paris Museum Pass
- Île de la Cité
- Notre Dame Cathedral
- Sainte Chapelle
- Montmartre
- Paris transport (Metro, RER, buses)
- Interactive maps and location guides
- Opening hours and ticket prices
- Museums (Musée Cluny, Musée Guimet)
- Place de la Concorde and Place Vendôme
- Travel planning and visitor information
- Paris churches and religious sites

## Major Attractions & Neighborhoods

- [Latin Quarter in Paris - One of the Liveliest Areas of Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/latin-quarter): Guide to Latin Quarter (Quartier Latin), historic student district near Sorbonne
- [Conciergerie - Opening Hours, Tickets and Location in Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/conciergerie): Historic prison where Marie Antoinette was held, with visiting details
- [La Madeleine - One of the Most Surprising Churches in Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/madeleine-church): Neoclassical church with Greek temple design and Corinthian columns
- [Basilique de Saint-Denis - Opening Hours, Tickets and Location](https://www.introducingparis.com/basilica-saint-denis): First Gothic church and French royal burial site with visitor information
- [Shopping in Paris - Stores, High Streets and Department Stores](https://www.introducingparis.com/shopping): Shopping guide featuring Galeries Lafayette, Printemps, and BHV stores

## Museums & Cultural Sites

- [Musée Guimet - Opening Hours, Price and Location](https://www.introducingparis.com/musee-guimet): Asian art museum guide with hours, admission prices, and location details
- [Musée des Arts Décoratifs - Opening Hours, Price and Location](https://www.introducingparis.com/musee-arts-decoratifs): Decorative arts museum near Louvre with hours, prices, and visitor info

## Transportation & Getting Around

- [T+ Ticket - Individual and Single-Way Transport Ticket in Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/t-ticket): Guide to T+ ticket for Metro, RER, and buses with 90-minute transfers
- [Paris Batobus - The Seine river-boat service](https://www.introducingparis.com/batobus): Seine hop-on hop-off boat shuttle with stops at Eiffel Tower and museums
- [Paris Taxis - Paris taxi information and fares](https://www.introducingparis.com/taxi): Taxi rates, fares to airports, and contact info for Paris taxi services

## Travel Planning Essentials

- [Climate of Paris - Climate and weather forecast of Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/climate): Paris continental climate guide with seasonal temperatures and rainfall
- [Public Holidays in Paris - France](https://www.introducingparis.com/public-holidays): French public holidays including Bastille Day for trip planning

## Interactive Maps & Location Guides

- [Map of Paris - Latin Quarter in Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/map/latin-quarter): Interactive map of Latin Quarter showing monuments and museums nearby
- [Map of Paris - La Madeleine](https://www.introducingparis.com/map/madeleine-church): Interactive map showing La Madeleine church location with nearby landmarks
- [Map of Paris - Jardin du Luxembourg](https://www.introducingparis.com/map/jardin-du-luxembourg): Interactive map showing Jardin du Luxembourg location and surroundings
- [Map of Paris - Château de Vincennes](https://www.introducingparis.com/map/chateau-vincennes): Interactive map showing Château de Vincennes location with Google Maps
- [Map of Paris - Dalí Paris](https://www.introducingparis.com/map/espace-dali): Interactive map showing Dalí Paris museum location and nearby landmarks
- [Map of Paris - Orly Airport](https://www.introducingparis.com/map/orly-airport): Interactive map showing Orly Airport location relative to Paris
